meta.name: mem-setup
meta.description: This skill should be used when the user asks to "set up claude-mem", "pair claude-mem", "connect cmem", "add my cmem key", "set up cloud sync in Cowork", or provides cmem.ai Connect values (sync token, user id, SyncHub URL) for this plugin. Configures the claude-mem-cowork plugin credentials.

howto.what: 它会把你的 cmem.ai 凭据(sync token、user id、SyncHub URL)写进插件的 config.json,让 hooks 能捕获和注入记忆;缺值时向你追问,验证时只显示脱敏输出。
howto.when: 当你要求设置或连接 claude-mem,或直接提供 cmem.ai Connect 的三个值时接管。

howto.what_en: It writes your cmem.ai credentials (sync token, user id, SyncHub URL) into the plugin's config.json so hooks can capture and inject memory; it asks for missing values and shows only masked output when verifying.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask to set up or connect claude-mem, or paste cmem.ai Connect values (sync token, user id, SyncHub URL).

say_en.text: Set up claude-mem with my cmem.ai Connect info
say_en.note: Credentials go into the plugin's config.json

say_en.text: Pair claude-mem with my cmem sync token and tell me if I need to repackage
say_en.note: It explains the container is ephemeral
